The raw feature-query bytes were not returned by the current web transport, so no polygon coordinates are fabricated; exact adopted identifier 35 is retained and local OpenCode performs boundary resolution and parcel join.

evidence_slice: London Datastore states that the OPDC Local Plan Policies Map illustrates all site-specific policies in the OPDC Local Plan adopted in June 2022 and that its Site Allocations dataset contains 42 sites used to demonstrate supply of land for new housing, commercial and industrial floorspace. The official OPDC Local Plan table identifies Site Allocation 35 as 4 Portal Way in place P7 with capacity for 702 homes, 1,946 sqm of economic floorspace and 140 jobs. The GLA-hosted OPDC public policies FeatureServer layer 25 is named Site Allocations and is an esriGeometryPolygon layer with site_name and site_reference fields.
binding_method: adopted local-plan spatial dataset plus exact site-allocation identifier and official polygon service metadata; feature extraction and canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
